title: rseng-agent-skills: research software engineering skills for AI coding agents
description: A research software engineering skills pack for AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI): 67 skills covering research software practice, with workflow commands, subagents and a phased practice-enforcement layer. Skills are hand-authored against verified primary references; part of the content was originally adapted from two CC-BY-4.0 community sources, RSQKit by the EVERSE project and the Netherlands eScience Center Software Development Guide (see ATTRIBUTION.md).
